recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-13669 unless a future mapping tutorial review separately decides to change the dependent-group example semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-13669 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for STU3 asking to correct the Mapping Language Tutorial step 7 example from a malformed dependent group call using a left brace before s_aa to the normal parenthesized call ab_content(s_aa, t_aa).
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was applied on September 6, 2017. Git commit 150060340bd1e4c694a3af8bcb4f5d5f4e5ac1b7 explicitly names GF# 13669 and changed source/mapping-tutorial.html from ab_content{s_aa, t_aa) to ab_content(s_aa, t_aa).
additional_context: The current tutorial source has been modernized since the STU3-era text, but the relevant example still contains the corrected ab_content(s_aa, t_aa) call. source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini show mapping-tutorial.html remains in current build scope. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-13669-specific discussion or later work-group record changing the typo-only conclusion; one later Zulip dependent-group thread mentions ab_content but not a surviving syntax typo.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/mapping-tutorial.html already contains the requested correction and a targeted rg search found no remaining ab_content brace/star typo forms in that file. The published combined-branch commit is an empty no-change audit record.
